description: Machine-readable mirror of docs/dev-tracker.md. Keep both files in sync. Identifiers use descriptive kebab-case slugs (see descriptive-slug-ids ADR).

items.scope: Remove the hardcoded YouTube Data API key from plugins/youtube and resolve it from runtime configuration so revoked/restricted keys do not require a code change.
acceptanceCriteria: YoutubeConf no longer embeds a concrete API key value.
YoutubePluginManager resolves the key from runtime configuration.
trayView configuration exposes a user-editable YouTube API key field persisted in local user configuration.
Playlist API request URL only includes supported parameters.
Error messages include API request context while masking key values.
items.pr: fix(youtube): externalize data api key and mask api errors (#29)
items.notes: End users can set the key from the tray configuration tab. Runtime key lookup order: Java property habitv.youtube.apiKey, then environment variable HABITV_YOUTUBE_API_KEY. Risk youtube-key-hardcoded mitigated.

items.displayTitle: JAXB generated sources & launcher classpath recovery
items.scope: Restore Maven/IDE visibility for JAXB-generated packages in application/core and fix HabitvLauncher classpath setup without broad dependency remediation or provider modernization.
acceptanceCriteria: JAXB outputs land under target/generated-sources/jaxb and are registered as compile source roots for config, configuration, and grabconfig.
HabitvLauncher compiles on Java 8 without Utils4J.addToClasspath.
application/core/generated remains gitignored for legacy local trees while fresh builds use target/generated-sources/jaxb.
validation: mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests clean compile -> BUILD SUCCESS (33 modules)
git diff --check -> clean on committed files
items.pr: fix: restore generated sources and launcher classpath (#44)
items.notes: application/habiTv now uses a small Java 8-compatible local URLClassLoader helper instead of the unavailable Utils4J.addToClasspath API. Incompatible utils4j Java 17 bytecode and broader transitive dependency vulnerability cleanup remain out of scope for a dedicated security PR.
